sourceFindings.finding: HTTP body reads use one owned65536byte bytearray backing, checked through __alloc__==65537 before use. IncompleteRead keeps its actual partial bytes, records transportError even for an empty partial, rejects partial larger than the supplied target and does not mark the transfer complete. A bounded partial is not silently replaced with synthetic bytes. Its exception-provided bytes can be an additional HTTP-owned backing term; this review does not equate them with the fixed normal slot.

Received bodyBytes/hash are updated before persistence as in the prior accounting; on persistence failure they must not be interpreted as proof that the bodyRef file has those bytes. The explicit failure prevents a successful-transfer claim.
